rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
Fantasy is not escape only — it mirrors real fears and desires symbolically.
Identify the 'impossible' element and explain its realistic meaning.

rows.text: Trick 1: Fantasy questions test SUSPENSION OF DISBELIEF — explain how the writer makes impossible events feel real (consistent rules, vivid detail, relatable characters).  ·  Trick 2: Symbol questions: fantasy objects usually symbolise real desires or fears — name the symbol and its real-world meaning.
